correctness.rationale: Over Fq, Br(Fq)=0 and Pic(S)=Pic(Sbar)^F integrally; geometric degree-five del Pezzo has Picard lattice diag(1,−1,−1,−1,−1) and ten (-1)-curve classes. Frobenius acts through W(A4)≅S5. For each of the seven permutation cycle types, the primitive integer kernel of F−I gives arithmetic intersection matrices; Smith diagonals, determinant signs, gcd of maximal minors of exceptional-curve orbit sums, and exact cone inequalities recover every row of the table. In particular (3,1,1) has orbit-trace index 3 and (4,1) index 2; other five indices 1. An independent SymPy checker rebuilt 120 W(A4) actions with all 7 orbit type counts, all seven Gram Smith signatures, trace indices, Mori and nef ray counts (10/10,7/7,4/4,4/4,2/2,2/2,1/1). Realizability over every finite field follows from Trepalin Proposition 3.1, not finite sampling; the cone generators follow by averaging effective exceptional rays under Frobenius.
